mapper.sql: select id, contract_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, file_category, is_final, version, sort_order, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from proj_contract_attachment
mapper.insert: insert into proj_contract_attachment ( contract_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, file_category, is_final, version, sort_order, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{contractId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{fileCategory}, #{isFinal}, #{version}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.select: select id, attachment_id, contract_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, file_type, file_category, is_final, version, action, operator, operate_time, remark from proj_contract_attachment_log where attachment_id = #{attachmentId} order by version desc
